decision.latency_rule: a latency regression counts only beyond max(5 ms, 2x the rule baseline's p95) per address — 5 ms is 2% of the 250 ms resolve-path budget, declared in advance; error/hit/NDCG metrics need no margin because they are exact given a ranking
decision.reason: no learned challenger cleared the declared bar; the rule baseline remains the product, which the architecture pre-registers as a legitimate outcome (M3b/D42)
decision.rule: adopt a learned ranker only if it beats RULE on the primary S-VAL metric beyond the paired grouped-bootstrap interval, regresses nothing (coverage, strata n>=15, refusal, availability, latency, leakage), and stays directionally consistent on leave-block-out

determinism.note: every fit uses the same seed; tree building is deterministic given the seed and the row order, which is the manifest's sorted address order

f_agreement_count: sutra/ranking.py ← pairwise distances inside the candidate set
f_arm_prior: sutra/ranking.py ARM_PRIOR ← the candidate's own arm
the arm is the candidate's provenance, known at query time
f_baseline_stratum: the pin's own declared precision, present in the supplied file
f_granularity_rank: coarse/fine claim of the candidate itself
f_locality_name_matched: sutra/ranking.py ← localities.csv vs the address text
address text × official gazetteer, no visit
f_n_candidates: sutra/ranking.py ← the candidate set of this query
how many candidates were retrieved — no truth involved
f_outside_town: a property of the address string
f_pin_unknown: sutra/ranking.py ← address text pin vs localities.csv pins
consistency of the address's own pin

spec.note: the only place surveyed truth may be read; increments the test-look counter

label.S_Eval_label: surveyed_ground_truth, read once, after the freeze
label.definition: independently-confirmed field position as of the cut-point (sutra.replay._proxy_truth); grades 3/2/1/0 at <=100/250/500 m

secondary.name: warm (all arms — circular diagnostic)
secondary.note: the proxy label is the address's own promoted check-in median, so the evidence arms reproduce it; this lane is a diagnostic for the plan's '(-) memory features' ablation and never feeds the decision

negative_controls.agent_only_control_note: not runnable by construction: the frozen M2 feature set contains no agent or account field (audited above), so an 'agent-ID-only' model cannot be fitted without inventing a feature — the audit replaces it

question: given the existing official candidate set, can an inspectable learned ranker order the candidates better than the deterministic rule-priority ranker?

runtime_cost.note: scoring cost is measured over the S-VAL addresses of the static lane; the full resolve path is reported by the acceptance suite
